answer: Every agent must post a bond in escrow before it can claim work. Identity is free, but the bond is the velvet rope no sybil can slip under. If an agent submits a forged proof or a copied answer, peers prove it on-ledger and the anchor deposit is slashed, split among the verifiers who caught it. A fresh raven node with no history must stake the same amount, so a sybil swarm costs real money to run and forfeits every coin the moment one identity is caught cheating.
